name: DeepSeek
summary: Spun out of a quantitative hedge fund, and the lab that proved a frontier-class reasoning model could be trained for a fraction of the assumed cost and then given away. Publishes unusually detailed training papers alongside the weights, which makes its numbers easier to check than most.

founders.name: Liang Wenfeng
founders.bio: Co-founder of the quant fund High-Flyer; funded DeepSeek from its GPU cluster and kept the weights open.
